newsitem.title: USA: CBT Corp to buy Republic Bank branch.
newsitem.headline: CBT Corp to buy Republic Bank branch.

text.p: CBT Corp said Wednesday it has reached a definitive agreement with Republic Bank & Trust to acquire the Murray, Ky. office of that bank.

CBT said it will purchase the deposits and fixed assets of the Republic Bank office for an undisclosed amount. The loan portfolio will not be acquired. The Murray bank will then become a part of CBT's United Commonwealth Bank operation.

The acquired office has $20 million in deposits and will bring United Commonwealth Bank's deposits to about $75 million. Subject to regulatory approval, CBT said the Republic Bank office should become part of United Commonwealth in 90 days.
